newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE--Fillmore Central School Dist, N.Y..

text.p: SEALED PROPOSALS will be received and considered by th President of the Board of Education of Fillmore Central Scho District, Allegany and Wyoming Counties, New York at the off of Fleet Bank, Private Banking Department, Mezzanine Level, East Avenue, Rochester, New York 14638, until 11:00 A.M.,

at which time and place the bids will be opened, for the pur IN FEDERAL FUNDS at not less than par and accrued interest o $6,711,000 School District (Serial) Bonds, 1996, (the "Bonds maturing on June 15 of each year as follows:

The Bonds will be dated December 15, 1996 and will bear int payable semi annually on June 15 and December 15 of each yea commencing June 15, 1997. The Bonds will be awarded to the bidder offering to purchas Bonds at such rate or rates of interest as will produce the lowest net interest cost in accordance with the terms set fo in the Notice of Sale. The Bonds maturing on or after June 15, 2005 are subject to redemption at the option of the School District in accordanc with the terms set forth in the Notice of Sale. The School District will designate the Bonds as "qualified exempt obligations" pursuant to Section 265(b)(3) of the Int Revenue Code of 1986, as amended. The Bonds will be issued by means of a book-entry-only syst with The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York, which act as securities depository for the Bonds. The School Dist will furnish the Bonds and the approving legal opinion of St John & Curtin, Rochester, New York, on or about December 18, 1996. The School District reserves the right to change the time a date for the opening of bids. Notice of any such change sha provided not less than 24 hours prior to the time set forth

for the opening of bids by means of a supplemental noti to be transmitted over The Munifacts Wire. Requests for copies of the Notice of Sale herein summarized the Official Statement relating to the Bonds and such other information as the State Comptroller may prescribe by rule o order may be directed to Bernard P.
